newsitem.title: USA: Siltek unit in Mexico probed by US agency.
newsitem.headline: Siltek unit in Mexico probed by US agency.

text.p: A U.S. Labor Department agency said Tuesday it had agreed to review workers' rights at a Silitek Corp subsidiary in Mexico, under the auspices of the North American Free Trade Agreement.

The National Administrative Office (NAO) said it had received a submission alleging abuses at Silitek subsidiary Maxi-Switch SA, which produces high technology computer keyboards in Cananea, in the Mexican state of Sonora.

The NAO said the submission alleged Mexico failed to ensure impartial labor tribunals for workers at Maxi-Switch, infringed the freedom of association and the right to organize and failed to enforce Mexican labor laws.
The NAO, the Labor Department agency responsible for administering the labor side agreement to NAFTA, has 120 days to review the submission and report its findings to the Secretary of Labor.
